entries.title: All-k dense regression against minimum-cover-first search
entries.source_lifecycle: Unreviewed candidate/regression in frozen open source PR #957; theorem-state remains authoritative.

claim.statement: For every integer k>=4 the report constructs a rational triangle-free source A_k with D=k^2 and |A_k|=pi D^2/(2 sqrt(3))+O(D), plus a packet B_k of size |A_k|-1. The source has exactly one unit contact and |A_k|-2 contact isolates; its complete cross-conflict graph is a matching. The unique minimum-cardinality diameter cover has exchange profit -1, but a k-label inclusion-minimal cover has profit 0 and produces a same-cardinality competitor of diameter D-1/8.
hypotheses: All source, packet, and cross-pair inequalities in the report’s rational construction.
The source is explicitly nonglobal; the competitor is part of the regression proof.
not_claimed: No global minimizer or Level I counterexample is constructed.
The regression rejects only a minimum-cover-first shortcut; all-k population is analytic with O(D) error, not an exact optimum.

relation_to_canonical.comparison_scope: No canonical theorem is used as an unpromoted premise; the report depends only on the problem definition and its proved finite graph identity.

artifacts.role: all-k analytic regression and complete construction

dependencies.description: This regression is part of the same joint objective but is a separate reusable negative control; it prevents replacing the joint minimization by minimum cover cardinality.

obstructions_and_limits.result: Every constructed source is strictly nonglobal; the packet explicitly reduces diameter by 1/8 at fixed cardinality.
The scripts check k=4,5 only; the all-k family and population estimate are analytic.

validation.result: PASS; exact rational full pair ledgers at k=4,5, including all 55 and 254 contact isolates.
validation.boundary: Finite exact checks do not establish packet existence for arbitrary global minimizers or promote the analytic proof.

next_proof_obligations: Keep the minimum-cover-first counterexample in future exchange searches and test every cover/matching cost jointly.
Do not use dense nonglobal sources as evidence against Level I.

entries.title: Four-label weak-cage obstruction to uniform free-region propagation
entries.source_lifecycle: Unreviewed candidate/regression in frozen open source PR #957; theorem-state remains authoritative.

claim.statement: For rational t>0, a center with three unit neighbors u=(1,0), v=(-(1-t^2)/(1+t^2),2t/(1+t^2)), w=(0,-1) is triangle-free and has a positive surrounding relation a*u+v+b*w=0. For any prescribed R>0, choosing t<1/(4R) places all four labels outside the radius-R ball centered at (Rt,R), while the center lies only R*(sqrt(1+t^2)-1) outside its boundary. The affine line through u,v misses the center by t/sqrt(1+t^2).
hypotheses: Rational 0<t<min(1,1/(4R)); use the exact identities and inequalities in the historical run note.
This is a local geometric obstruction only; source globality is not assumed.
not_claimed: No global minimizer, source-hull free-ball extraction, or counterexample to Level I.
No uniform affine-span/free-region radius can be inferred from triangle-freeness alone.

relation_to_canonical.comparison_scope: No canonical theorem is used as an unpromoted premise; the report depends only on the problem definition and its proved finite graph identity.

artifacts.role: historical route ledger and analytic weak-cage regression

dependencies.description: The destination already retains a distinct dense two-copy Schurmann-near-miss; this bounded four-label cage adds an explicit arbitrary-radius placement and does not subsume that family.

obstructions_and_limits.result: Schurmann’s propagation theorem requires uniform geometry hypotheses not supplied by triangle-freeness; the cage blocks dropping them.
The four-label configuration is a nonglobal local regression and cannot be promoted to a source theorem.

validation.result: Analytic finite configuration and source-agent audit only; no global source claim or independent destination review.

next_proof_obligations: Any free-region proof must derive its uniform geometry controls from global optimality or use a collective full-source move.
